llm.summary: This skill is a documentation-writing helper with no executable payload, though its broad trigger words may make it activate more often than intended.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently focus on generating, polishing, and remediating documentation, comments, and docstrings; the requested reading, editing, and quality checks fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger list includes broad terms such as writing, generation, remediation, and polish, which could route unrelated requests through this skill, but the actual instructions remain documentation-focused.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown guidance files only, with no executable scripts, binaries, declared package dependencies, or automatic install-time actions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may read a project-local style profile and suggests verifying paths, links, and example commands; this is proportionate for documentation work when kept user-directed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It can lead the agent to make persistent documentation or docstring edits, but it explicitly limits code-file changes to comments/docstrings and calls for approval on major restructuring or final output.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want help drafting or cleaning project documentation. Review diffs before accepting edits, avoid putting secrets in .scribe style profiles, and approve any proposed command checks explicitly.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The artifact confirms broad triggers, but this is a scoping note rather than a material security concern because the skill has no hidden executable behavior, credential handling, network exfiltration, or high-impact mutation authority.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, which is consistent with the inspected markdown-only artifact.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal status is pending and provides no adverse evidence; it did not influence the benign verdict.
